_comment: Per Lex locale (key = our language code in languages.json): sample utterances for the catch-all intent, the filler lines Lex says after 1 s (start, one picked at random) and every 5 s (update) while Booqy thinks. Every code in languages.json needs an entry here; only codes in languages.json become locales (no, zh, yue, ro and cy: Connect language codes still to be confirmed on a real call). Utterances avoid punctuation (Lex sample utterance rules). Trimmed to 7 utterances and 2 start lines per locale: the template must stay under CloudFormation's 51,200 byte limit with 25 locales (both intents go to the same code hook, so the samples only need to exist).
